evidence.quote: For this reason, I believe it makes sense to cut the FOMC's policy rate by 25 basis points two weeks from now.
First, tariffs are one-off increases in the price level and do not cause inflation beyond a temporary surge.
This is why I say private-sector payroll gains are near stall speed and flashing red.
I also believe—and I hope the case I have made is convincing—that the risks to the economy are weighted toward cutting sooner rather than later.
I would support further 25 basis point cuts to move monetary policy toward neutral.
